description: This file defines matrix data structures and factory methods for local matrices in Apache Spark's MLlib, including dense and sparse matrix implementations, with support for various operations and conversions.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: Sealed trait for local matrices, providing common matrix operations and conversions.

classes.name: DenseMatrix
classes.description: Class representing a dense matrix stored in column-major order, with methods for creation, copying, and conversion.

classes.name: SparseMatrix
classes.description: Class representing a sparse matrix in compressed sparse column (CSC) format, with methods for creation, copying, and conversion.

methods.name: fromVectors
methods.description: Creates a dense or sparse matrix from a sequence of vectors, choosing the more efficient representation.

methods.name: dense
methods.description: Creates a dense matrix with specified size and values.

methods.name: sparse
methods.description: Creates a sparse matrix in CSC format with specified size, column pointers, row indices, and values.

methods.name: fromBreeze
methods.description: Converts a Breeze matrix to a Spark MLlib matrix.

methods.name: zeros
methods.description: Creates a dense matrix filled with zeros.

methods.name: ones
methods.description: Creates a dense matrix filled with ones.

methods.name: rand
methods.description: Creates a dense matrix with uniformly distributed random values.

methods.name: randn
methods.description: Creates a dense matrix with Gaussian distributed random values.

methods.name: diag
methods.description: Creates a diagonal dense matrix from a vector.

methods.name: sprand
methods.description: Creates a sparse matrix with uniformly distributed random values.

methods.name: sprandn
methods.description: Creates a sparse matrix with Gaussian distributed random values.

methods.name: spdiag
methods.description: Creates a diagonal sparse matrix from a vector.
